# Announcement Feature Control Plan
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

**Result:** The announcement feature is authorized for local implementation as a post-launch increment under CHG-53 (Add administrator-managed announcements with formatted portal content, dashboard and sidebar placement, automatic email, and user-local time display).

## Approved Direction

- Administrators can save drafts, preview, publish, edit, pin, unpin, and archive announcements.
- Content includes a title, plain-text summary, and restricted formatted body with headings, bold, italic, lists, and HTTP(S) links.
- The dashboard card sits below the welcome section and above metrics.
- `Announcements` appears after `Home` in the sidebar.
- Participants receive a paginated published list and protected detail pages.
- First publication sends the title, summary, and protected detail link to approved, active, email-verified participants, moderators, and administrators.
- Portal and email times use the saved IANA timezone, with `Asia/Manila` (`GMT+8`) as the fallback.
- Database timestamps remain in UTC.
- Each announcement and recipient has at most one delivery record.

## Excluded From This Release

- Participant posts and comments
- Attachments and images
- Scheduled publishing
- Automatic expiry
- Resending on edit or pin changes
- Full community-feed completion

## Artifact Treatment

No additional maintained artifact is currently needed before implementation. Existing requirements and backlog records, application source and tests, PM Control records, and `application/ops/email-delivery.md` remain the carriers. The operations note must be updated if the implementation changes the supported queue or mail procedure.

## Acceptance Boundary

Local automated checks, browser and responsive checks, timezone checks, staging email evidence, operational handoff, participant-use acceptance, and release approval remain separate gates. No schedule baseline, cost baseline, production deployment, or full community requirement closure is implied.
